method: Executed official bitmap and Unihex provider load/bake, Font.drawInBatch(FormattedCharSequence), StringRenderOutput and BakedGlyph/Effect CPU methods in a headless JVM. A host bake function constructs native BakedGlyphs from observed SheetGlyphInfo bounds, synthetic normalized UVs and null GPU render types. Native FontSet info/baked/white caches are seeded with the selected original glyphs to bypass atlas allocation and FontSet selection/filtering. An observing MultiBufferSource/VertexConsumer records native vertices, colors, UVs and buffer request boundaries. Each sequence has two identical selected glyphs. This is not native atlas, shader, framebuffer, obfuscation pool or screen certification; no original game assets/classes are included.
